extracted.name: Honey BBQ Sauce
extracted.description: This smoky honey BBQ sauce recipe is easy to make at home and will rival anything you can buy! Delicious on wings, ribs, meatballs, or anything else.
instruction_lines: Stir ketchup, honey, vinegar, and molasses together in a saucepan over medium heat until smooth; add liquid smoke, salt, black pepper, paprika, chili powder, onion powder, garlic powder, and cayenne pepper. Stir the seasonings into the ketchup mixture, reduce heat to low, and simmer until thickened, about 20 minutes.
